summary: Flat kerb where cars park, backed by thick garden trees; homes 13-21 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Dense garden trees behind the kerb; nearest dwellings 13 m and 21 m, and a house 6 m off just beyond the section.

drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with a junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here regularly, so a van would not stand out; no camping seen.
